endorsements.name: Silvio Cesare
endorsements.label: Opensource Kernel Auditing and Exploitation
endorsements.description: For a period of up to 3 months in 2002, a part-time manual security audit of the operating system kernels in Linux, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, and NetBSD was conducted.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 11

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
